name: Serres
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

soil.rock: Schist, slate and gneiss break into stony, free-draining soil that holds the day's heat. Schist is rich in magnesium and potassium but poor in organic matter and nitrogen. Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water.

land: The high ground runs about 12°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.

winkler: Good for generous crops of standard to good wine.
